# High-risk paths for the risk gate (.github/workflows/risk-gate.yml).
# One regular expression per line, matched against changed file paths.
# A PR into `next` touching any of these waits for the owner's owner-ok label.
# Lines starting with # are ignored.
# The gate always reads this file from `next`, so a PR can't loosen its own check.

# GitHub automation (includes the hourly data workflow) and these rules
^\.github/

# The hourly data job: what it fetches from the Wiki and what it publishes
^job/

# Dependencies
(^|/)(package\.json|package-lock\.json)$

# Build, deploy and environment settings
^Makefile$
^vercel\.json$
^vite\.config\.
^\.env\.example$

# Export/backup of my own data (the flip log, later)
(^|/)(backup|export)
